scripts.test:rules: cd app && npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-nestmate "node ../scripts/run-rules-tests.cjs"
scripts.test:storage-rules: cd app && npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-nestmate "node ../scripts/run-storage-rules-tests.cjs"
scripts.test:emulators: cd app && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 npx -y firebase-tools emulators:start --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-nestmate
scripts.test:data: cd app && npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project demo-nestmate "node ../tests/seed/emulator-universe.cjs reset-seed-verify"
scripts.test:account-deletion: cd app && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-nestmate "node ../tests/seed/emulator-universe.cjs seed && node ../tests/integration/account-deletion.cjs"
scripts.test:api:business: playwright test tests/api/businessLogicApi.spec.ts tests/api/listingsApi.spec.ts tests/api/connectionsAndQuotaApi.spec.ts tests/api/matchingApi.spec.ts tests/api/messagingAndNotifsApi.spec.ts tests/api/moderationAndVerifApi.spec.ts --project=chromium --reporter=list
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --config app/firebase.e2e.json --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-nestmate "node tests/seed/emulator-universe.cjs seed && playwright test"
scripts.test:e2e:critical: cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --config app/firebase.e2e.json --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-nestmate "node tests/seed/emulator-universe.cjs seed && playwright test tests/e2e/00-environment-smoke.spec.ts tests/e2e/features/explore/exploreRooms.spec.ts tests/e2e/features/explore/exploreRoommates.spec.ts tests/e2e/features/listings/roomDetail.spec.ts tests/e2e/features/profile/profileManagement.spec.ts tests/e2e/features/chat/chatMessaging.spec.ts tests/e2e/features/settings/settingsManagement.spec.ts tests/e2e/security/securityBoundaries.spec.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:headed: cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 npx -y firebase-tools emulators:exec --config app/firebase.e2e.json --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-nestmate "node tests/seed/emulator-universe.cjs seed && playwright test --headed"
